title: EventEnvelope
description: Wraps every domain event Trellis publishes. Producers: the Java outbox relay. Consumers: Java and Python workers. Broker-agnostic: the same JSON travels over Kafka, Postgres or in-memory transports.

eventId.description: UUIDv7, unique per event. Consumers deduplicate on (consumerName, eventId).

eventType.description: <noun>.<past_verb>, e.g. notice.published. Also the logical topic name.

eventVersion.description: Payload schema major version. Additive changes keep the version; breaking changes bump it and publish both versions during migration.

aggregateType.description: PascalCase owner of the change, e.g. Notice.

aggregateId.description: Id of the aggregate. Also the partition key unless partitionKey says otherwise, so one aggregate's events stay ordered.

partitionKey.description: Optional override of the ordering key (defaults to aggregateId).

occurredAt.description: When the business change committed, UTC, RFC 3339.

producer.description: Service that wrote the outbox row, e.g. trellis-backend.

correlationId.description: Request or job correlation id; mirrored in the x-correlation-id header.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context of the writing request; mirrored in the traceparent header.

actor.description: Who caused the change. Never a secret or a token.

payload.description: The event body, validated against contracts/events/<eventType>/v<eventVersion>.schema.json. Carries the facts consumers need so they never call back the producer.
